G1.rationale: Postgraduate or undergraduate degree delivering comprehensive education in AI Strategy.
evidenceLines: The Graduate Certificate provides foundational capability through core courses in artificial intelligence (AI) fluency, responsible AI practice, and AI strategy. The program also offers opportunities to deepen these foundations through either a technical lens, developing practical programming skills, or a more philosophical perspective, examining the conceptual and ethical questions that shape how we think about AI. Designed for professionals with interest or some exposure to AI but limited formal knowledge, the courses build confidence in evaluating AI tools and their implications, applying ethical and governance principles to organisational decisions, and designing and communicating strategic uses of AI for diverse stakeholders.
